categories.definition: A material event is present but the system fails to detect or retain it.
Non-event, commentary, background, promotion, or stale material is incorrectly promoted as a current event.
Event date, duration, lifecycle state, or planned/completed status is misread.
Negation, failure, cancellation, rejection, or other polarity is reversed or lost.
A fact is assigned to the wrong event, subject, article focus, or evidence group.
The event subject or speaker/actor is incorrectly identified.
The material action or relation is incorrectly identified or generalized.
The material object, target, counterparty, or scope is lost or altered.
Same-event items fail to cluster or distinct events are incorrectly merged.
Old or background material is treated as a fresh event.
A claim is not supported by the cited evidence or official source.
Generated or extracted content introduces a claim not supported by evidence.
Generation drops a material verified fact.
Generation changes planned/completed or other temporal meaning.
Generation introduces a clear Korean grammatical or particle defect.
A local extraction, generation or QA failure incorrectly suppresses unrelated verified events or the whole publication.
